relationships.subject: ERK
relationships.evidence_quote: The acupuncture-induced ROCK2 expression was significantly attenuated by the ERK inhibitor, whereas phospho-ERK expression was not inhibited by ROCK inhibitor.

relationships.subject: Y-27632
relationships.evidence_quote: In both the formalin- and CFA-induced mouse pain models, acupuncture analgesia was blocked by ROCK inhibitor administration.

relationships.subject: ROCK2
relationships.evidence_quote: Acupuncture treatment-induced ROCK2 expression is a downstream effector of phospho-ERK in the skin and plays a crucial role in acupuncture analgesia.

relationships.evidence_quote: Acupuncture-induced ROCK2 and p-ERM expression was significantly attenuated by U0126 administration (p < 0.01; Fig. 3C-D).

ROCK inhibitor Y-27632 blocked acupuncture analgesia in formalin and CFA pain models.
